definition: A schedule used to calculate this document liability for individuals with net earnings from self-employment, including self-employed persons, church employees, partners, and those using optional methods to determine taxable self-employment income.

includes.text: Contains line items for calculating net earnings from self-employment income
Includes sections for reporting this document calculations
Contains instructions for determining this document obligations

excludes.text: Does not report itemized personal deductions or standard deduction amounts
Does not report overall individual income tax return information or filing status
Does not report rental real estate income or supplemental income from partnerships and S corporations

discriminators.text: Reports this document on net earnings from business and farm activities, whereas the sibling reports itemized personal deductions used to reduce taxable income
Calculates this document on business earnings as a supplemental schedule, whereas the sibling is the primary individual income tax return reporting total income and tax liability
Focuses exclusively on this document calculations from business and farm earnings, whereas the sibling reports rental real estate income, partnership income, and other supplemental income sources
